INTERNAL MEMORANDUM.

From B.13 (Major Langdon) ....... To B.4.c (Mr. Pilkington)

I attach copy of letter, ECW/KV/1096 of June 10th, from Whetmore, with reference to the LOEWNHEIM brothers.

The two photographs of the LOEWEHNEIM brothers are likewise returned herewith.

Date 12.6.41.

Signature P.H. Langdon

S. Form 161. for Lieut. Colonel Hinchley Cooke.
